name: Foresight Group Holdings Limited
summary: Foresight Group Holdings Limited, operates as an infrastructure asset and private equity investment manager that specializes in providing investment opportunities in private markets to institutional and retail investors worldwide. It operates in two segments, Foresight Infrastructure and Foresight Private Equity. The Foresight Infrastructure segment operates an infrastructure asset management team, which focuses on the renewable energy and infrastructure sectors. The Foresight Private Equity segment operates as a private equity and venture, and growth capital investment management team that focuses on investment in the United Kingdom regional small and medium sized enterprises. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
